fits.wls: prespecified weighted-log fit of ln[1 - 2P(n)] (Eq. fit), primary for the X-memory decision
fits.binomial: binomial maximum-likelihood refit of all round counts (App. stats)

per_placement.method: observed: inverse-variance mean over the five days, se widened by sqrt(chi2/nu) when chi2/nu > 1 (nu = 4); binomial sigmas are half-widths of the quasi-likelihood 68% profile intervals. predicted: plain mean over the five days of the model's prediction (each job's measured f), fitted with the same estimator. ratio = observed / predicted_mean; its se carries the observed error only. Lambda is pooled from the daily ratios. The t test is within one placement (nu = 4); there is no chip-level test.

placements_compared.note: No chip-level estimate, p-value or upper bound is given: on every day these were the only usable distance-5 sites, and they overlap. Random-effects and Birge-widened two-placement results were dropped at the outside reviewer's request (docs/diagnosis/revision/stats/placement_stats.json still holds them and must not be cited).

registered.note: Record only (appendix): the rule treats the ten repetitions as independent.

xy_variance_correction.what: old: Var(ln r) = (1 - r^2)/(N r^2) as registered (run.py:1059); new: delta method for separately sampled <X> and <Y>, Var(ln r) = [x^2(1-x^2)/N_X + y^2(1-y^2)/N_Y]/r^4 (with the (1+1/N) shot-noise factors).

downstream.source: docs/diagnosis/revision/xy_fix/{compare,reanalysis,reanalysis_control,combined_fixed,combined_control}.json; control = unpatched rerun in the same environment

largest_observed_Lambda_X_change.note: observed values move because the decoder weights depend on f

calibration_scatter_check_exploratory.label: exploratory; the added spread comes from the predictions only (calibrations and idle-test f)

heating_exploratory.what: Fractional change of each error rate from the start (t=0) to the end (t=1) of a job's shots; slope of the series-normalized rate against time. See heating.py docstring.
